name: evoarena-dynamic-v1
protocol: Online solve-score-update; skill persists for the entire run
selection: One longest original complete chain per repository, requiring full unique-task coverage
rationale: Separate previously used development repositories from the primary online benchmark.
The benchmark adapts after each scored task rather than freezing skill throughout a static test set.
Shuffle complete repository blocks using predefined seeds; keep original milestone order inside every block.
Use each unique task once in a primary run so overlapping chains do not create replay or historical backtracking.
Retain every original chain in separate full-chains manifests for explicit replay experiments.
Optional warmup and benchmark must run in the same invocation to preserve skill; keep warmup scores separate.
